$comment: Team edits to the figure registry, written by the in-site data editor, which was removed with the sign-in in November 2026; the edits it made stay and are still applied. Change it only through a reviewed pull request. `patches` changes fields of an existing figure by id; `added` holds figures the team created. lib/data/figures.ts applies both, so derived figures recompute and every page, chart, CSV and the explorer follow. npm run verify checks the result before any edit reaches main.
